pooled_p_task_decision.definition: sum per-trace paired counts over all conditions (natural, instruction, empty, slip ghost + park), then divide (t55_study pair_stats); CI = episode-block bootstrap B 10000 seed 5507 over 16 episodes
pooled_p_task_decision.recompute_agreement: equal at 4 decimals (hsr d_fr 0.007634 d_fp -0.011941 d_lat 0.1 d_und 0; noun d_fr 0.015267 d_fp -0.044589 d_lat 0.0 d_und 0)

recompute.method: numpy only, no repo imports: own causal hysteresis K=2, HELD = reground phase 'held', HSR flag = kv_L4_v1 softmax p(place) >= 0.9, noun flag = noun_probe softmax p >= 0.3 and noun_ok, own onset/latency
